parts.name: Leg
parts.also_called: LEG (VERTICAL); Leg; sofa leg; bed post (short)
parts.description: Vertical leg, any section (square, turned, tapered). Tall bed posts use 813.

parts.name: Bottom stretcher front/back
parts.also_called: BOTTOM STRETCHER FRONT / BACK; bottom back stretcher
parts.description: Low stretcher between legs, running along the width (front and back).
parts.standard_rule: 40 x 40, length as drawn

parts.name: Bottom stretcher left/right
parts.also_called: BOTTOM STRETCHER LEFT / RIGHT; side stretcher; Bottom stretcher S/S
parts.description: Low stretcher between legs, running front to back (sides).

parts.name: Center stretcher
parts.description: Stretcher joining the two side stretchers in the middle (H-frame tables, benches).

parts.name: Plinth front/back
parts.description: Recessed base board under a case or kitchen cabinet, front and back.

parts.name: Plinth left/right
parts.description: Base board on the sides of a plinth base.

parts.description: Central support of a pedestal or trestle table.

parts.also_called: base arm; trestle foot; spider foot

parts.name: Leg block

parts.description: Small block reinforcing a leg-to-rail corner.

parts.description: Rail joining the legs at the top, along the width (front and back). Apron on tables.

parts.name: Top rail left/right
parts.also_called: top rail front to back; side apron
parts.description: Rail joining the legs at the top, front to back (sides).

parts.description: Horizontal front rail between drawers or between drawer and door.

parts.name: Mid rail back
parts.description: Horizontal back rail matching a mid rail front.

parts.name: Drawer runner rail left/right
parts.description: Rail on the inside of the case side that carries a drawer or slide.

parts.name: Bottom rail front/back
parts.description: Rail joining the legs at the bottom of the case body, along the width.

parts.name: Bottom rail left/right
parts.description: Rail joining the legs at the bottom of the case body, front to back.

parts.name: Top stretcher
parts.description: Cross member under the top that the top is fixed to.

parts.name: Vertical support
parts.description: Vertical member inside or on the front of a case.

parts.name: Horizontal support
parts.description: Horizontal member inside a case or frame that is not a rail.

parts.name: Drawer kicker
parts.description: Rail above a drawer that stops it tipping when opened.

parts.name: Drawer guide
parts.description: Center guide for a drawer without metal slides.

parts.name: Face frame stile
parts.description: Vertical member of a face frame on the front of a case.

parts.name: Face frame rail
parts.description: Horizontal member of a face frame on the front of a case.

parts.name: Cleat

parts.description: Strip that fixes a top, panel, or wall-hung unit.

parts.name: Other frame part (describe)
parts.description: Frame part not listed. Write the name in the BOM.

parts.name: Side panel
parts.description: Side panel of the case body. Always a panel, never solid (owner 13 Okt).
parts.standard_rule: (clear depth + 10) x (body H + 10), 2 per case

parts.name: Back panel
parts.description: Back panel of the case body. Every case has one (owner 13 Okt).

parts.name: Back panel frame
parts.also_called: frame @ back panel; Back frame (rail & stile)
parts.description: Solid frame holding the back panel: rails and stiles.
parts.standard_rule: 40 x 25: 2 rails (clear width + 10) + 2 stiles (body H + 10) + 1 middle stile per divider, added automatically

parts.name: Center panel
parts.description: Panel held inside a frame (frame-and-panel side, back or end).

parts.name: Center panel frame
parts.also_called: frame @ center panel; panel frame stile/rail

parts.name: Bottom panel
parts.also_called: case bottom; floor panel; base panel
parts.description: Horizontal panel closing the bottom of the case body.

parts.name: Divider
parts.description: Vertical internal panel between compartments.
parts.standard_rule: (clear depth + 10) x (opening H + 10)

parts.name: Shelf, fixed
parts.description: Fixed shelf.

parts.name: Shelf, adjustable
parts.description: Shelf resting on shelf pins (906).

parts.name: Fixed horizontal panel
parts.also_called: sub-top; dust panel; drawer deck; intermediate bottom
parts.description: Horizontal panel inside the case that is not a shelf (under the top, between drawer and door zones).

parts.name: End panel
parts.description: Exposed finishing panel on the end of a cabinet run.

parts.name: Filler
parts.description: Strip that closes a gap to a wall or between units.

parts.name: Edge lipping
parts.description: Solid strip glued to a visible panel edge (shelves, sides).

parts.name: Mirror
parts.description: Mirror glass (wall mirror, dresser mirror, wardrobe door).

parts.name: Mirror frame
parts.description: Frame around a mirror.

parts.name: Mirror back panel
parts.description: Backing board behind a mirror.

parts.name: Other panel (describe)
parts.description: Panel not listed. Write the name in the BOM.

parts.name: Drawer front
parts.description: Visible front of a drawer.

parts.description: Left and right sides of the drawer box.

parts.name: Drawer box front
parts.also_called: INNER DRAWER; Drawer box front (inner); drawer box front/back
parts.description: Inner front of the drawer box, behind the drawer front.
parts.standard_rule: W = front W - 64; H = front H - 30; 1 per drawer

parts.name: Drawer box back
parts.also_called: BACK DRAWER; Drawer back; drawer box front/back
parts.description: Back of the drawer box.
parts.standard_rule: W = front W - 64; sits on the drawer base; 1 per drawer

parts.name: Drawer base
parts.also_called: BOTTOM DRAWER; Drawer bottom; drawer base
parts.description: Bottom panel of the drawer box.
parts.standard_rule: 1 per drawer, in a 5 mm groove

parts.name: Drawer front back panel
parts.description: Panel behind a framed or woven drawer front that closes it from the inside.

parts.name: Drawer front trim left/right
parts.description: Vertical solid trims on the left and right of a framed drawer front.

parts.name: Drawer front trim top/bottom
parts.description: Horizontal solid trims on the top and bottom of a framed drawer front.

parts.name: Drawer front center panel
parts.also_called: rattan woven @ drawer front center; drawer front insert
parts.description: Infill inside the drawer front trims. Material code says what it is (rattan, cane, veneer panel).

parts.name: False drawer front
parts.description: Fixed front that looks like a drawer but does not open.

parts.name: Pull-out tray
parts.description: Tray or hidden drawer behind a door.

parts.name: Other drawer part (describe)
parts.description: Drawer part not listed. Write the name in the BOM.

parts.name: Door panel
parts.description: Slab door, or the whole door when it is one panel.
parts.standard_rule: From opening: W = opening W / no. of doors - 2, H = opening H - 2

parts.name: Door frame stile
parts.description: Vertical members of a framed door.

parts.name: Door frame rail
parts.description: Horizontal members of a framed door.

parts.name: Door center panel
parts.also_called: door insert; rattan @ door center; glass @ door
parts.description: Infill inside a framed door. Material code says what it is (veneer panel, rattan, glass).

parts.name: Door back panel
parts.description: Panel behind a woven or framed door that closes it from the inside.

parts.name: Door trim
parts.description: Applied trim or moulding on a door.

parts.name: Sliding door
parts.description: Door running on a track (911).

parts.name: Flap door
parts.description: Door hinged at top or bottom, with a stay (910).

parts.name: Louver slat
parts.description: Slat in a louvered door or panel.

parts.name: Other door part (describe)
parts.description: Door part not listed. Write the name in the BOM.

parts.name: Top panel
parts.also_called: TOP PANEL; Top; top / daun meja
parts.description: Top of a case, nightstand, desk or console.
parts.standard_rule: Size as drawn, 1 per item

parts.name: Table top
parts.description: Top of a dining, coffee or side table.

parts.name: Top edge front/back
parts.description: Solid edge on the front and back of a top.

parts.name: Top edge left/right
parts.description: Solid edge on the ends of a top.

parts.name: Top insert
parts.also_called: inlay; leather inlay; stone insert; glass insert
parts.description: Insert set into a top. Material code says what it is.

parts.name: Countertop
parts.description: Kitchen or vanity worktop (stone, solid surface, wood).

parts.name: Backsplash

parts.name: Extension leaf

parts.name: Other top part (describe)
parts.description: Top part not listed. Write the name in the BOM.

parts.name: Seat rail front/back

parts.description: Front and back rails of a seat frame.

parts.name: Seat rail left/right
parts.description: Side rails of a seat frame.

parts.name: Seat cross rail
parts.description: Cross member inside a seat frame.

parts.name: Seat deck
parts.description: Panel the seat cushion or foam rests on.

parts.name: Back stile
parts.description: Vertical members of a backrest frame.

parts.name: Back rail
parts.description: Horizontal members of a backrest frame.

parts.name: Back slat
parts.description: Slats or spindles in a chair back.

parts.name: Back panel, outside
parts.description: Panel closing the outside of an upholstered back.

parts.name: Arm
parts.description: Armrest of a chair or sofa.

parts.name: Arm post
parts.description: Vertical support under an armrest.

parts.name: Arm panel
parts.description: Panel forming an upholstered sofa arm.

parts.name: Webbing / springs

parts.description: Seat or back suspension (bought in).

parts.name: Foam, seat

parts.name: Foam, back
parts.description: Foam for the back.

parts.name: Foam, arm
parts.description: Foam for the arms.

parts.name: Wadding
parts.description: Fibre wrap over foam.

parts.name: Seat cushion
parts.description: Loose seat cushion (foam + cover).

parts.name: Back cushion
parts.description: Loose back cushion.

parts.name: Scatter cushion
parts.description: Decorative cushion.

parts.name: Upholstery cover
parts.description: Fabric or leather cover. Quantity in metres.

parts.name: Dust cover
parts.description: Cloth under a seat or base.

parts.name: Other seating part (describe)
parts.description: Seating part not listed. Write the name in the BOM.

parts.name: Headboard panel
parts.description: Main panel of the headboard.

parts.name: Headboard frame
parts.description: Solid frame of the headboard.

parts.name: Headboard pad
parts.description: Upholstered pad fixed to the headboard.

parts.name: Footboard panel
parts.description: Main panel of the footboard.

parts.name: Footboard frame
parts.description: Solid frame of the footboard.

parts.name: Bed side rail
parts.description: Long rails joining headboard and footboard.

parts.name: Bed end rail
parts.description: Rail at the foot end when there is no footboard.

parts.name: Bed center rail
parts.description: Rail running head to foot in the middle.

parts.name: Center support leg
parts.description: Leg under the center rail.

parts.name: Slat ledger
parts.description: Strip on the side rail that carries the slats.

parts.name: Bed slat
parts.description: Wood slat made in-house.

parts.name: Bed base

parts.description: Bought-in bed base set; replaces slats.

parts.name: Bed post
parts.description: Tall corner post of a bed (four-poster, frame bed).

parts.name: Other bed part (describe)
parts.description: Bed part not listed. Write the name in the BOM.

parts.standard_rule: 1 set per drawer, length = drawer box side

parts.name: Handle
parts.description: Handle or knob.
parts.standard_rule: Entered manually (owner 13 Okt)

parts.name: Floor glide
parts.description: Glide under a leg.
parts.standard_rule: 1 per leg

parts.name: Adjustable leg
parts.description: Adjustable plastic or metal leg under a cabinet.

parts.name: Shelf pin

parts.name: Flap stay
parts.description: Stay or lift for a flap door or lid.

parts.name: Sliding door track
parts.description: Track set for a sliding door.

parts.name: Castor
parts.description: Wheel under a piece.

parts.name: Lighting
parts.description: Light fitting in or on a piece.

parts.name: Hanging rail

parts.description: Cover for a cable hole.
